title: BJ's Brewhouse Copycat Honey-Crisp BBQ Chicken Chopped Salad
ingredients: 1 lb crispy breaded chicken breast tenders or grilled chicken breast, chopped
1 cup black beans, rinsed and drained
1/2 cup shredded Monterey Jack & Cheddar cheese
1/3 cup crispy fried onion strings or tortilla strips
1/3 cup smoky Hickory BBQ sauce (for drizzling)
1/2 cup buttermilk ranch dressing + fresh chopped cilantro
instructions: Air-fry or bake the chicken tenders (or grill seasoned chicken breasts) at 400°F for 12–14 minutes until golden and crisp, then dice into bite-sized pieces.
In a large chilled bowl, toss the chopped Romaine and iceberg lettuce with buttermilk ranch dressing.
Arrange the dressed greens on platters and top in rows with black beans, roasted corn, diced tomatoes, cheddar-jack cheese, and warm crispy chicken.
Drizzle generously with smoky BBQ sauce and top with crunchy onion strings and fresh cilantro.
